texts: The European Parliament approved the new climate law on Wednesday. The legislation requires member states to cut emissions by 55 percent by 2030. Several countries had opposed the measure for months, arguing that it would harm their industries.

Rescue teams found the missing hikers on Sunday morning. The group had been lost in the mountains for three days when a helicopter spotted their tent. All four were taken to hospital, where doctors said they were in good condition.

The museum reopened to the public last week after a two-year renovation. Visitors can now see the restored frescoes in the main hall. The building had been closed since 2021 because of structural problems.
Shares in the technology company rose by eight percent after it reported record profits. Analysts had expected a smaller increase. The company also announced plans to hire two thousand new employees.

The river is the longest in the country and flows for more than a thousand kilometres. It has been an important trade route since Roman times. Today it is also popular with tourists, who travel along it by boat.
Police arrested a man on Friday in connection with the robbery. Officers said he had been living in the city under a false name for several years. He will appear in court next week.

The novelist was born in Dublin in 1882 and moved to Paris in 1920. She had worked as a teacher for a decade before she published her first book. Her novels have been translated into more than thirty languages.

The strike ended on Thursday after the union accepted a new offer. Workers had been protesting for six weeks when the government finally agreed to negotiate. Trains are expected to run normally from Monday.

Scientists have discovered a new species of beetle in the rainforest. The insect is only a few millimetres long and lives in the leaves of tall trees. Researchers believe there may be hundreds of similar species that have not yet been described.

The old bridge was built in the fifteenth century and is one of the oldest in Europe. It had carried traffic for over five hundred years before it was closed to cars in 1998. Today only pedestrians are allowed to cross it.

Heavy snow caused chaos across the region on Tuesday. Many roads were closed and hundreds of flights were cancelled. By the time the snow stopped, some villages had been without electricity for two days.
The president met the prime minister in Rome on Monday. The two leaders discussed trade, security and immigration. They had met twice before, but this was their first official visit.
The festival takes place every summer in the old town. It attracts more than a hundred thousand visitors from all over the world. This year the organisers have added a new stage for young musicians.
The company was founded in 1950 by two brothers. It had produced bicycles for forty years before it switched to electric scooters. Today it employs more than five thousand people in twelve countries.
When the earthquake struck, the town's residents had been preparing for the annual festival for weeks. Many buildings collapsed, and the festival was cancelled. Aid workers arrived the next morning.
The species was considered extinct for almost a century. In 2015, a small population was discovered on a remote island. Conservationists have since been working to protect its habitat.

The team won the championship after a dramatic final. They had been losing by two goals at half-time, but scored three times in the second half. Thousands of fans celebrated in the streets until late at night.

The central bank raised interest rates for the third time this year. Inflation has been rising since the spring, driven by higher energy prices. Economists expect further increases before the end of the year.
The castle stands on a hill above the village. It was built by a local lord in the twelfth century and later rebuilt after a fire. The family that owns it opens the gardens to visitors every Sunday.
Doctors say the patient had been suffering from headaches for months before he was diagnosed. The tumour was removed successfully last week. He is expected to make a full recovery.

The election will take place in November. Opinion polls suggest that the two main parties are almost level. The outcome will depend on the votes of young people, who have traditionally voted less often.

Archaeologists working near the coast have uncovered the remains of a Roman villa. The building had been buried under the sand for nearly two thousand years. The team found mosaics, coins and pieces of pottery.
The singer cancelled her concert on Saturday because of illness. Fans who had been waiting outside the stadium for hours were told to go home. The concert will be rescheduled for next month.
The city introduced a new bus network last year. Since then, the number of passengers has increased by twenty percent. The mayor has promised to extend the network to the suburbs.
Before the dam was built, the valley had flooded almost every spring. Farmers had lost their crops many times. The dam now provides electricity for more than a million homes.
The minister resigned on Tuesday after a newspaper revealed that she had misused public funds. She denied any wrongdoing. The prime minister thanked her for her service and appointed a replacement.
The forest covers almost half of the country's territory. It is home to bears, wolves and many species of birds. In recent years, illegal logging has become a serious problem.
When the firefighters arrived, the warehouse had been burning for more than an hour. Nobody was injured, but the building was completely destroyed. The cause of the fire is still unknown.
The professor taught at the university for thirty years. During that time, he wrote more than twenty books on ancient history. Many of his former students are now teachers themselves.
The airline announced that it would cancel all flights to the island. The airport had been closed for three days because of the hurricane. Thousands of tourists are still waiting to return home.
Coffee became popular in Europe in the seventeenth century. The first coffee houses opened in Venice and London. They quickly became places where people met to discuss politics and business.
The two countries signed a peace agreement in 1995. They had been at war for almost a decade. Since then, trade between them has grown steadily.

Engineers inspected the tunnel after residents reported cracks in the walls. They found that water had been leaking into the structure for years. The tunnel will be closed for repairs until the end of the year.
The writer spent the last years of his life in a small house by the sea. He continued to write every morning until he was ninety. His final novel was published after his death.
The government has promised to build ten new schools by 2027. Teachers' unions welcomed the plan but said it was not enough. Many classrooms are already overcrowded.
By the time the ambulance reached the village, the injured climber had been waiting on the mountain for six hours. Rescuers had to carry him down on a stretcher. He is now in a stable condition.
The orchestra will perform Beethoven's Ninth Symphony at the opening concert. Tickets went on sale on Monday and sold out within an hour. The concert will also be broadcast live on television.
The lake freezes every winter, and local people skate on it. Last year, however, the ice was too thin. Scientists say that winters in the region have been getting warmer for decades.
The company had been struggling financially for years before it was bought by a rival in 2019. The new owners closed two factories and moved production abroad. Hundreds of workers lost their jobs.
The village has fewer than two hundred inhabitants. Most of the young people have moved to the cities in search of work. The local school closed in 2010, and the nearest shop is ten kilometres away.
